grievance.title: Grievance redressal
grievance.metaDescription: Raise a privacy, data or content grievance with our Grievance Officer.
grievance.subtitle: Raise a concern about your personal data, your consent, or content on the platform.
grievance.officerFallback: Use the form on this page; it goes straight to our Grievance Officer.
grievance.sla: We acknowledge every grievance within {hours} hours and aim to resolve it within {days} days. If you are not satisfied, you may complain to the Data Protection Board of India.
grievance.signInToTrack: <link>Sign in</link> to track the status of your grievances.
grievance.emailHintSignedIn: Optional: we will use your account email if you leave this blank.
grievance.emailHintAnon: Required so we can reply to you.
grievance.subject: Subject
grievance.describeHint: Include listing or order references where relevant. Do not include passwords or card details.
grievance.receivedBody: Reference: {id}. We will acknowledge it within {hours} hours and resolve it by {date}.
grievance.followSignedIn: You can follow its status under Your account, Grievances.
grievance.followAnon: Keep this reference; we will reply to the email address you gave.
grievance.myDescription: Status of the grievances you have raised.
grievance.loadError: We could not load your grievances right now. Please try again in a moment.
grievance.emptyDescription: If you have a concern about your data or content, raise it and we will respond within the statutory window.
grievance.requestType: What would you like to do?

type.access: Get a copy of my personal data
type.nomination: Nominate someone to act for me (nominee)

grievance.consentIdHint: Add it if this is about your cookie choice. We fill it in when this browser has one.
grievance.slaRights: Requests to use your data rights are answered within {days} days.
grievance.verifyEmailSent: Check your email: we sent a confirmation link to the address you gave. We can only act on your data request once you open it (within 7 days).
grievance.verifyDone: Thank you, your email is confirmed. Your request is now with our Grievance Officer.
grievance.verifyInvalid: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired. File your request again if you still need it.
